text: Clarice Starling, a young FBI trainee at Quantico, is sent to interview Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant cannibalistic psychiatrist held in a Baltimore hospital for the criminally insane, in the hope he can help catch [Buffalo Bill, a killer who skins young women|threat|people who kill]. When Catherine Martin, a senator's daughter, [is abducted|trigger|someone goes missing] and held in a dry well in a basement, Lecter trades clues for Clarice's memories, [a quid pro quo|rules|everything has a price] that draws out her father's murder and [the spring lambs she could not save|wrong|failing to protect].
